uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: Automatically cleanses this Pokémon every 6s, even if there are no effects to cleanse. Removes all status condition from the Pokémon. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered.
Becomes a boosted attack after 6s, dealing increased damage. This boosted attack remains readied until used. Becomes a boosted attack after a set amount of time passes, dealing increased damage.
Becomes a boosted attack after a set amount of time passes, dealing increased damage.

The user pounds in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 40% for 2s. Has the user attack by pounding in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time when it hits.

The user hurls an egg at the designated location that explodes, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing them away from the center of impact for 0.8s. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move, and there is a 2s cooldown between uses. If the user learns both Soft-Boiled and Egg Bomb, the uses kept in reserve for Egg Bomb is added to Soft-Boiled's reserve pool; this reserve pool is shared between both moves. The base cooldown for both moves becomes 5s. The cooldown between using the same move remains at 2s. Hurls an egg at the designated location. The egg then explodes, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and throwing them.
Decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by 40% for 2s. Also decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when they are thrown by this move.

The user increases the movement speed and basic attack speed of themself and nearby teammates by 30% for 4s. When buffed, the user's auto attacks also become boosted attacks. For a short time, greatly increases the user's and nearby allies movement speed and basic attack speed. While this move's effects last, all of the user's basic attacks become boosted attacks.
Increases the auto attack damage of all teammates buffed by this move by 15% for 4s. Increases the damage of basic attacks while this move's effects last.
The user restores the HP of themself and a designated teammate every 0.5s over 2s. Continually restores the user's and designated ally HP for a short time.

The user throws an egg to a designated teammate, restoring the HP of themself and the designated teammate. The user and the designated teammate restore HP over time every 1s over 2s afterward. Subsequent uses of this move overwrites any HP over time the user and the designated teammate is yet to restore from previous uses. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move, and there is a 2s cooldown between uses. Throws an egg to an ally, restoring its HP as well as the user's HP. A maximum of 3 uses can be kept in reserve for this move and cannot be used more than once every 2s.
Gains 1 additional use kept in reserve. Increases the maximum number of uses that can be kept in reserve.

The user cleanses themself and a designated teammate, and grants the user and the teammate a shield that makes them unstoppable for 4s. Blissey grants both the targeted ally and themself a shield, purging hindrances and making both immune to hindrances as long as the shield lasts.
Strengthens the value of the shield effect. Shield value increased.

The user becomes unstoppable and dashes to the designated ally Pokémon to give it an egg, granting that ally a shield and increasing their Attack and Sp. Atk by 20% for 6s. The user also intercepts 50% of the post-mitigation damage received by that ally as unmitigated damage for 6s. While dashing, opposing Pokémon hit are damaged and thrown into the air for 0.8s. When reaching the target ally, nearby opposing Pokémon are damaged again. Has the user dash to the designated ally to give it an egg, granting that ally a shield and increasing its Attack and Sp. Attack for a short time. The user also intercepts a portion of the damage received by that ally for a short time. While dashing, the user throws nearby enemies and those it comes in contact with.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
